description: The contract Artifact Set table (lines 18-28) lists shared types at 'packages/shared/src/types.ts' but does not list the evidence log files that it references in lines 76-77 (.vcsdd/features/billing-service/evidence/sprint-1-red-phase.log and sprint-1-green-phase.log). The contract also claims 'isUncertainError extracted to shared errors.ts during refactor' (line 68) but isUncertainError is in packages/billing-service/src/shell/errors.ts, not in a shared package. The term 'shared errors.ts' is misleading -- it is the billing-service shell layer's errors.ts, not a package-level shared module.

evidence.snippet: isUncertainError extracted to shared errors.ts during refactor

remediation: Clarify the contract: (1) 'shared errors.ts' should read 'shell/errors.ts' to avoid confusion with the @hayane/shared package. (2) Evidence log files should be listed in the artifact set if they are referenced as pass criteria.
